highlights.title: A message an agent never ran is reported
highlights.line: On Windows, if an agent takes in your message but stops or never starts on it, its card says so and you get a notice to send it again.

highlights.title: Shared tasks say who has finished
highlights.line: A task with several agents now says which of them have finished and who is still on it, on the board and in task lists.

highlights.title: Agents that answer you elsewhere say so
highlights.line: When an agent says it answers you on another channel, its chat now says so in place of "Nothing back yet."

highlights.title: An old Grok sign-in says since when
highlights.line: A Grok sign-in not renewed for over three days now reads "not confirmed since" a date, not "Signed in".

highlights.title: An old Meta Muse sign-in says since when
highlights.line: On the Mac, a Meta Muse sign-in not seen working for over three days now reads "not confirmed since" a date, not green.
